description: §15.10 (S458 "D1") — a DECLARED prop is the component's input and never reaches the expanded root as a DOM attribute. `Card` declares `title`, `href`, `disabled`, `id` (all real HTML attribute names) and writes none of them on its root; it is used at the top level (an `${expr}` value and literal values), inside `<each>`, inside a `lift`, and inside a `<match>` arm. No `.card` carries `title=` / `href=` / `disabled` / `id=`; the body's `${title}` / `${id}` reads render.
rationale: §15.10: 'The value a call site passes for a declared prop SHALL NOT be written onto the expanded component's root element (or any other element) as a DOM attribute — at the top level, inside `<each>`, inside a `lift`, and inside an engine or `<match>` arm alike'. §66.14 rule 4: use-site attributes are construction.
